User Request: Show every category and the number of products in it, including categories with zero products.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Product Count by Category
Type: table
Description: Displays each category and the number of products in it, including categories with zero products.

sql_queries.title: Product Count by Category
sql_queries.description: Displays each category and the number of products in it, including categories with zero products.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, COUNT(p.ProductID) AS ProductCount FROM Categories c LEFT JOIN Products p ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryID, c.CategoryName
